question.text: 'Chola Cat II AIF' has a committed corpus of INR 600 crore. The drawdown schedule is: Year 1 = 40%, Year 2 = 30%, Year 3 = 20%, balance at discretion. By the end of Year 2, what is the TOTAL called capital (fund-level)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Cumulative drawdown through Year 2 = 40% + 30% = 70%. Called capital = 70% x INR 600 cr = INR 420 crore. The Trap: Option A counts only Year 1. Option B counts only Year 2 in isolation. Option D adds Year 3's 20% prematurely, taking the figure to 90%. Note: When asked for cumulative called capital up to a given year, sum the cumulative drawdown percentages and apply to the committed corpus.
